title_en: 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Graduate Scholarship: Call for Applicants
summary: Students entering the general graduate school in Spring 2027, or admitted in Fall 2026, with a cumulative GPA of at least 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) in their previous program may seek university recommendation for the 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation graduate scholarship. All recommendation documents, including the departmental recommendation form, are due by email by Wednesday, 18 February 2027; the email address and contact are in the original notice. Final recommended candidates will be notified to departments on Wednesday, 24 February 2027 at 15:00.
applies_to: Optional (not mandatory). Open to students in the general graduate school (master's, doctoral or integrated master's-doctoral program) who are either incoming new students for Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기) or were admitted in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기), and who have a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) or higher in their previous program. Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10. Detailed eligibility is in the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2), which was not read.

dates.what: Deadline to submit all documents, including the departmental recommendation form, by email
Final recommended candidates notified to departments

conditions: Each department may recommend at most 2 students; the College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10 in total.
A cumulative GPA of at least 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) in the previous program is required.
If no documents are received by the deadline, it is treated as having no candidate to recommend.

If more than 10 apply within the College of Engineering, candidates are selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale: undergraduate grades for master's and integrated master's-doctoral entrants, and master's grades for doctoral entrants.
Ties are broken by undergraduate grades (overall GPA, then percentile).
The scholarship can be received together with national and university scholarships.
The scholarship cannot be received together with scholarships from other private foundations.
If national or university scholarships already cover both tuition and living expenses, the scholarship amount will be adjusted.
The scholarship is up to KRW 6,000,000 per semester for a maximum of 4 semesters.
Students who pass the document screening must also take part in the expert review (stage 2) and the interview (stage 3).
steps: Read the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2-1) and the scholarship regulations (Attachment 2-2) for detailed eligibility; their content was not read for this translation.

Prepare the departmental recommendation form (referred to as Attachment 4 in the notice), the recommendation list (Attachment 3, 2027년도 관정장학생 추천명단(대학원).xlsx), the personal information consent form (Attachment 4, 개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서) and any other required documents.
Submit all documents by email (address in the original notice) by Wednesday, 18 February 2027; contact the department office (contact in the original notice) with questions.
Check with your department after Wednesday, 24 February 2027, 15:00, whether you were selected as a final recommended candidate.
If recommended, check your email for the foundation's guidance on online document submission and follow it.
If you pass the document screening, attend the expert review (stage 2) and the interview (stage 3) according to the foundation's schedule.
translation:
2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation New Graduate Scholarship: Call for Applicants

The 2027 Kwanjeong Educational Foundation new graduate scholarship recipients will be selected as follows.

A. Number of recommendations: at most 2 per department. ※ The College of Engineering plans to recommend at most 10.

B. Eligibility: incoming new students of the general graduate school (master's, doctoral or integrated master's-doctoral program) for Spring 2027 (2027학년도 1학기), or students admitted in Fall 2026 (2026학년도 2학기), with a cumulative GPA of 3.8/4.3 (4.0/4.5) or higher in their previous program.
※ For detailed eligibility, see the scholarship selection plan [Attachment 2].

C. Scholarship amount and support period
- Type: Kwanjeong Academic Encouragement Scholarship (Type B)
- Program: graduate
- Amount per semester (maximum 4 semesters): up to KRW 6,000,000
- Nature: academic encouragement grant
- Notes: may be received together with national and university scholarships. ※ May not be received together with scholarships from other private foundations. ※ If national or university scholarships provide both tuition and living expenses, the scholarship amount will be adjusted.

D. Recommendation selection procedure
1) Deadline for submitting all documents, including the departmental recommendation form [Attachment 4]: 2027. 2. 18. (Wed), by email (address in the original notice).
※ If no reply is received by the deadline, it will be treated as having no candidate.
※ If applications exceed the College of Engineering's quota (10), candidates will be selected by GPA on a 4.3 scale (master's and integrated master's-doctoral entrants: undergraduate grades; doctoral entrants: master's grades). In case of a tie, selection is by undergraduate grades (overall GPA, then percentile).
2) Notification of final recommended candidates to departments: 2027. 2. 24. (Wed) 15:00.

Notes
1) For details on scholarship selection, you must check the foundation's selection plan (Attachment 2).
2) The foundation will email the university's recommended candidates with guidance on online document submission; please make sure to check it.
3) Students who pass the document screening must take part in the expert review (stage 2) and the interview (stage 3); recommended candidates should be informed of the screening schedule.

Attachments (4) — their content was not read:
2-1. 2027 Domestic University Scholarship Selection Plan (2027년 국내대학 장학생 선발계획) (PDF)
2-2. Regulations on Domestic University Scholarship Selection and Payment, 10th revision (국내대학장학생선발및장학금지급규정) (PDF)
3. 2027 Kwanjeong Scholarship Recommendation List, Graduate (2027년도 관정장학생 추천명단(대학원).xlsx)
4. Consent Form for Collection, Use and Provision of Personal Information (개인정보 수집·이용 및 제공 동의서) (HWP)

Note: the notice calls the departmental recommendation form Attachment 4, but the attachment list labels Attachment 4 as the personal information consent form and Attachment 3 as the recommendation list. Contact the department office (contact in the original notice) if unsure.
